purpose: Part 2/2 of verified inheritance-closure 11-record item effect batch 026; inherited base rules are preserved by reference and no missing mechanics are guessed.

items/harness-of-armor.name: Harness of Armor
items/harness-of-armor.effectSummary: A harness of armor functions as bracers of armor of the corresponding +1 through +8 bonus, but occupies the vest body slot instead of the bracers slot, leaving the wearer free to use other magic bracers.

items/tasmias-heart.name: Tasmia's Heart
items/tasmias-heart.effectSummary: Tasmia's Heart functions as both a helm of underwater action and a ring of freedom of movement. It also doubles the number of years remaining in each of the wearer's future age categories and doubles the wearer's maximum-age interval. It occupies the shirt body slot.

items/orb-of-tempests.name: Orb of Tempests
items/orb-of-tempests.effectSummary: The orb functions like a crystal ball, allowing scrying with Will DC 16 to negate. Once per day the viewer can also create control weather centered on the person or location currently visible through the orb.

items/enveloping-pit-390.name: Enveloping Pit [Relic]
items/enveloping-pit-390.effectSummary: For a lawful-evil, lawful-neutral, or neutral-evil user, the item functions as a portable hole except that it is 50 feet deep and can open from a 1-foot-diameter opening up to a 10-foot square as available flat space permits. With the relic connection to Kurtulmak, it can be opened or closed by command word from within 60 feet; a creature suddenly standing over it falls in unless it succeeds on Reflex DC 22 and can move to an adjacent safe square.

items/cloak-of-the-sorcerer-king.name: Cloak of The Sorcerer-King
items/cloak-of-the-sorcerer-king.effectSummary: The cloak grants +6 enhancement to Charisma. Once per day for each chromatic-dragon aspect, the wearer can activate one aspect as a standard action for 1 minute; no other aspect can be active during that duration. Black grants acid resistance 30, one darkness use at caster level 18, and automatically extends and empowers sorcerer spells with the acid or water descriptor; Blue grants electricity resistance 30, one ventriloquism use, and extends and empowers electricity- or earth-descriptor sorcerer spells; Green grants acid resistance 30, one suggestion use, and extends and empowers acid- or air-descriptor sorcerer spells; Red grants fire resistance 30, one locate object use, and extends and empowers fire-descriptor sorcerer spells; White grants cold resistance 30, one fog cloud use, and extends and empowers cold-descriptor sorcerer spells. These metamagic effects do not increase spell level or casting time.
